# MOSei

> MOSei is a management operating system platform for manufacturing and operations leaders, built around the Norman System, a proprietary framework for diagnosing and closing the gap between external pressure and internal regulation in an organization. MOSei is created by Norm Applegate, a consultant with over 30 years of MOS implementation experience.

MOSei helps operations and plant leaders name, measure, and close the gaps that cause instability under pressure: unclear ownership, slow decisions, and degraded information as it moves through an organization. The core diagnostic tools score these gaps directly and point to a specific constraint to fix first.

## Core Concepts

- [What Is Norman's Gap?](https://mosei.org/normans-gap.html): the instability that results when external pressure exceeds an organization's internal regulation.
- [What Is Signal Compression?](https://mosei.org/signal-compression.html): how organizations lose the truth, clarity, and urgency of a problem as it moves through layers.
- [What Is a Management Operating System (MOS)?](https://mosei.org/management-operating-system.html)
- [How to Build a Management Operating System](https://mosei.org/how-to-build-a-management-operating-system.html)
- [Management Operating Systems in Manufacturing](https://mosei.org/manufacturing-management-operating-system.html)
- [What Is a Daily Management System?](https://mosei.org/daily-management-system.html)
- [Tier Meeting System for Plant Managers](https://mosei.org/tier-meeting-governance.html)

## Diagnostic Tools

- [Gap Diagnostic](https://mosei.org/gap-diagnostic.html): scores the gap between external pressure and internal regulation across Ownership, Decision Speed, and Information Quality, and returns a Primary Constraint and a Bigger Drag.
- [MOS Assessment](https://mosei.org/mos-assessment.html): scores Management Operating System maturity against the Implementation Maturity Index (IMI) and returns a level and priority recommendations.
- [Implementation Readiness Diagnostic](https://mosei.org/implementation-readiness-diagnostic.html)
- [AI Gap Diagnostic](https://mosei.org/ai-gap-diagnostic.html): whether AI-driven pressure is outrunning an organization's regulation.
- [Gap Index Scorer](https://mosei.org/gap-index.html)
- [Scenario Finder](https://mosei.org/scenario-finder.html)
